title: Vienna antifascist memorial march after the 2 November terror attack
location: Vienna; KOMintern notice says Schwedenplatz, while Akin retrospective ends at Desider-Friedmann-Platz
participants_original: Akin retrospective says about 650 people; single source, approximate.
threshold_50_evidence: Akin retrospective reports about 650 people marched on 4 November. This is a single-source attendance report.

start_date.summary: KOMintern announced the 4 November gathering; Akin retrospectively lists a 4 November march.

location.summary: Organizer notice gives Schwedenplatz as start; Akin says a silent march ended at Desider-Friedmann-Platz.

demands.summary: Organizer notice called for solidarity against hatred and criticized Western/EU imperialist and militarist policy; no specifically Austrian policy target established.

organizer.summary: KOMintern published the notice; full event organizer coalition is not established.

participants.summary: Akin retrospectively reports about 650; no independent contemporaneous count identified.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; available source does not document participant violence.

notes: Actual march and approximate threshold are reported retrospectively by Akin. The organizer notice’s policy language criticizes Western/EU imperialism and militarism, but a specifically Austrian state demand is not clear.
open_questions: Find a contemporary execution report and a second source for attendance.
Determine whether the documented demands targeted Austria or only EU/Western policy.

title: Vienna taxi convoy against the planned Gelegenheitsverkehrsgesetz amendment
location: Vienna, from Wagramer Straße near Arbeiterstrandbadstraße via Reichsbrücke/Prater to Vordere Zollamtsstraße
organizer: Wiener Taxiinnung; Resul Ekrem Gönültaş identified as organizer
participants_original: ORF reports hundreds of taxi drivers demonstrated. Separately: police counted 1,400 taxis; organizers claimed twice as many vehicles. Krone says more than 1,400 taxis according to Taxiinnung. Vehicle totals are not treated as human attendance counts.
threshold_50_evidence: ORF explicitly describes hundreds of taxi drivers as demonstrating. The separate 1,400 figure is a police taxi/vehicle count; organizer vehicle count is twice that.

start_date.summary: Both reports identify the Wednesday afternoon taxi protest as 25 November 2020.

end_date.summary: ORF says the action ended shortly after 17:00 on the same day.

location.summary: ORF supplies the convoy route through Vienna; Krone identifies route from the Arbeiterstrandbad to the responsible minister’s ministry.

organizer.summary: ORF identifies Wiener Taxiinnung official Resul Ekrem Gönültaş as organizer.

demands.summary: Opposition to the planned amendment of the Gelegenheitsverkehrsgesetz, which organizers said threatened the taxi trade and fair working conditions / enabled price and social dumping.

participants.summary: ORF separately describes hundreds of drivers demonstrating; police counted 1,400 taxis and organizers counted twice as many. Krone reports more than 1,400 taxis by the Taxiinnung. Vehicle counts remain distinct from people.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: “Hundreds of taxi drivers” is an explicit qualitative estimate of persons; 1,400 taxis are recorded as vehicles only.

state_response.summary: Transport-minister staff received a delegation. Under the codebook, receipt of protest representatives is recorded as accommodation/meeting even though no assurances or policy concession were reported; other response categories are unreported.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; neither opened report describes protester violence.

notes: The actual public convoy, policy demand on a planned Austrian federal law, and a qualitative count of hundreds of drivers are supported by opened local ORF and Krone reports. Preserve distinction between human crowd and vehicles; ORF’s hundreds of drivers support the threshold without converting taxis to people. ORF notes a delegation was received by ministerial staff but no assurances were given. Count-source independence is limited: reports rely on police/organizer estimates.
open_questions: ORF story carries agency credit; do not assume its estimate source independent of other reporting.
No exact number of people independent of qualitative “hundreds”; keep numeric bounds null.
No policy change or commitment reported.

threshold_50_evidence: No evidence of actual execution or a participant count; the scheduled march does not establish the 50-person threshold.

location.summary: Notices schedule action at Maria-Restituta-Platz and a march through the neighborhood toward Wallensteinplatz.

notes: The notices specify opposition to planned FZ closure by Vienna city and additional policy demands, but do not establish that the event occurred or how many attended. Do not include unless execution and threshold are verified.
